verdict.rationale: Gide Loyrette Nouel is a law firm offering legal advisory services such as venture capital, IP, data protection and M&A work, not a software product, so an official CLI is a category error for this kind of product. Its internal use of AI and other technologies is not evidence of a client-facing CLI, and the probes found no API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
